safety_prerequisites.G0: BASE-01 is read-only preparation. This map grants no deletion, migration, process stop, credential access, deployment or activation authority.
safety_prerequisites.G1: Use the current owning Plan task and exact allowed paths. Replacement/caller/error/recovery acceptance, independent nonauthor review and required native exact-head statuses precede delivery.
safety_prerequisites.G2: Reconcile the exact Contracts consumer report and local project/import edges before source retirement. Missing or conditional input is not absence. Preserve independent consumers, shared ContentSandbox v1, all published artifact bytes and retired identity rows.
safety_prerequisites.G3: Do not remove critical old executors until both mandatory official MXC profiles plus Core, resource-before-exec/control, terminal, local and recovery acceptance pass on designated native hosts. No uncontained fallback or permanent dual runtime.
safety_prerequisites.G4: Stop new old-domain admissions; drain/explicitly stop owned processes; prove exclusive native/store ownership. Preserve or settle every UNKNOWN receipt/journal/quarantine/worker/recovery floor and coherent backup/key/epoch history; test restore. Live contraction is a later forward migration, never SQL-history rewriting.
safety_prerequisites.G5: CENTER-01 qualifies real fresh/schema10/schema11 transition, guarded runtime/credential/restore floors and approved coherent backup. Appending 0012 or replaying DDL does not admit schema10 or prove deployed schema11. H-03 blocks destructive operations, not read-only preparation.
safety_prerequisites.G6: Wire finished typed Go/Node APIs and real authorized view/control journeys. Remove obsolete navigation/route/bundle consumers at cutover; renderer fixtures are not business or native execution proof. Remote PTY/input remains out of scope.
safety_prerequisites.G7: Reconcile solution/package/lock/routes/worker/Docker/entrypoint/install/operational inventory to one accepted runtime. Preserve guarded main-push delivery, dark surfaces and immutable history. Public activation/channels need AFV2-PROD-01 prerequisites and concrete owner approval.
